scientific_integrity: Independent bitset and partition-state algorithms reproduce the finite classification and a six-vertex explicit witness. Analytic proofs establish the all-order recursion and asymptotic statement. Computation is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The all-order recursive characterization is proved; numerical rank thresholds are exhaustive only through forty vertices. No closed numerical formula for arbitrary order is claimed; historical priority is subject to accessible-source limitations.
title: Positive-gap recursion for online shattering of finite circular intervals
